items.headline: EPFO wage ceiling badha ₹25,000 hua
items.what: Cabinet ne EPFO ki mandatory coverage ka wage ceiling ₹15,000 se badha kar ₹25,000 kar diya hai. Isse adhik employees EPFO mein aa jayenge.
items.who: Jinke monthly wages ab ₹15,000 se upar aur ₹25,000 tak hain, un par EPFO rule lagu hoga.
items.action: HR/Payroll team apne employees ka salary check karein aur naye wage ceiling ke hisaab se EPFO me inclusion karein.

items.headline: Income Tax Rules: Forms 169/171 revise hue, deadline bhi extend hui
items.what: CBDT ne Income Tax Rules ke forms 169 aur 171 revise kiye hain. Sath hi in forms ki filing ki deadline extend ho gayi hai.
items.who: Woh taxpayers ya professionals jinhe ye forms file karne hain.
items.action: Form 169/171 file karne se pehle updated format download karein aur nayi deadline ka dhyan rakhein.

items.headline: Tax valuer, practitioner registration deadline badha March 2027 tak
items.what: CBDT ne tax valuer aur practitioner registrations ki deadline March 2027 tak badha di hai.
items.who: Jo income tax valuer ya practitioners registration kara rahe hai unke liye.
items.action: Valuer/practitioners apni registration March 2027 tak kara sakte hain, last date check kar lein.

items.headline: UPI payments par GST MDR lagu, customers ko charge nahi dena
items.what: UPI payments par Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) par GST lagu hai. Lekin sarkar keh rahi hai customers par yeh charge nahi daalna hai.
items.who: Sab merchants jo UPI payments accept karte hain.
items.action: Merchants MDR ka GST khud bear karein, customer se direct charge na lein.

items.headline: Gujarat GIS mapping se MSMEs ko PM Gati Shakti se link karega
items.what: Gujarat Sarkar ne MSMEs ka GIS mapping shuru kiya hai. Isse industrial data PM Gati Shakti portal se connect hoga.
items.who: Sab Gujarat ke MSME units aur business owners.
items.action: Aapki unit ka data sarkari listing/mapping me check karein, update ki zaroorat ho to department se sampark karein.

items.headline: Karnataka: Cinema ticket par 2% extra cess aayega
items.what: Karnataka Sarkar cinema tickets par 2% ka extra cess lagane ki planning kar rahi hai.
items.who: Sab theatre owners aur movie ticket sale par business karne wale.
items.action: Ticket rates update karne ke liye ready ho jao, system/ERP me naye cess ko add karo jab lagu ho.
